# registration: refusal codes, then the outcome of each determinism case
code already_consumed
code already_requested
code busy_refused
code issue_not_unknown
code no_deregistration_pending
code no_issue_pending
code no_runner_id
code not_consumed
code not_delivered
code not_issued
code not_requested
code presumed_leaked
code runner_id_mismatch
code runner_name_mismatch
code scale_set_degraded
code stale_run
code terminal
case already_consumed refused already_consumed
case already_requested refused already_requested
case busy_refused refused busy_refused
case busy_withdraws_the_retirement accepted
  deregistration_refused_busy/v1 {"retirement":"000000000000000000000000000000e1"}
case confirm_online accepted
  registration_connected/v1 {"runner_id":4242}
case deregister_after_the_job accepted
  deregistration_requested/v1 {"reason":{"retirement":{"retirement":"000000000000000000000000000000e2"}}}
case deregister_for_retirement accepted
  deregistration_requested/v1 {"reason":{"retirement":{"retirement":"000000000000000000000000000000e1"}}}
case deregister_leaked accepted
  deregistration_requested/v1 {"reason":"presumed_leaked"}
case issue_not_unknown refused issue_not_unknown
case mint_refused_is_absent accepted
  registration_absent/v1 {}
case newer_epoch_is_recorded accepted
  registration_epoch_advanced/v1 {"epoch":2}
  registration_delivered/v1 {}
case no_deregistration_pending refused no_deregistration_pending
case no_issue_pending refused no_issue_pending
case no_runner_id refused no_runner_id
case not_consumed refused not_consumed
case not_delivered refused not_delivered
case not_found accepted
  registration_deregistered/v1 {"answer":"not_found"}
case not_issued refused not_issued
case not_requested refused not_requested
case not_seen_online_presumed_leaked accepted
  registration_presumed_leaked/v1 {"reason":"not_seen_online"}
case pending_deregistration_records_nothing accepted
case presumed_leaked refused presumed_leaked
case reaper_finds_by_name accepted
  registration_found_by_name/v1 {"runner_id":4242}
case reaper_finds_nothing accepted
  registration_absent/v1 {}
case record_completed accepted
  registration_completed/v1 {"result":"failed"}
case record_consumed accepted
  registration_consumed/v1 {"request_id":1}
case record_delivered accepted
  registration_delivered/v1 {}
case record_issue_unknown accepted
  registration_issue_unknown/v1 {}
case record_issued accepted
  registration_issued/v1 {"runner_id":4242}
case removed accepted
  registration_deregistered/v1 {"answer":"removed"}
case request_registration accepted
  registration_epoch_advanced/v1 {"epoch":1}
  registration_requested/v1 {"attempt_id":"00000000000000000000000000000001","runner_name":"mf-pool0-host0-s0-g1-00000001","scale_set":7}
case runner_id_mismatch refused runner_id_mismatch
case runner_name_mismatch refused runner_name_mismatch
case same_job_records_nothing accepted
case scale_set_degraded refused scale_set_degraded
case stale_run refused stale_run
case terminal refused terminal
